sentence: The board decided to ___________ the merger after months of negotiation.
explanation_zh: "decide to V" 為固定用法,to 後面須接原形動詞 approve,而非 approving、approved 或 approves。

sentence: By next spring, the firm ___________ its headquarters to Singapore.
explanation_zh: by + 未來時間點,主句常用未來完成式表示「在該時間點之前已完成」,故用 will have relocated。

sentence: The auditor is in charge of ___________ all financial statements before year-end.
explanation_zh: in charge of 為介系詞片語,of 後面須接動名詞作受詞,所以是 reviewing,而不能用原形動詞或不定詞。

sentence: Before ___________ the new software, the IT team ran several test simulations.
explanation_zh: Before 在此作介系詞,後面須接動名詞 launching,表示「在啟用新軟體之前」。

sentence: The parcel, ___________ by the courier this afternoon, contains fragile items.
explanation_zh: 此處為分詞子句,parcel 與 deliver 是被動關係(包裹被遞送),故用過去分詞 delivered,相當於 which was delivered。

sentence: The firm intends to ___________ its market share in Southeast Asia next year.
explanation_zh: intend to V 為固定用法,to 後面須接原形動詞 expand。

sentence: Mr. Alvarez has ___________ this branch since it opened five years ago.
explanation_zh: since + 過去時間點,搭配 has,表示現在完成式,動詞須用過去分詞 managed。

sentence: While ___________ the inventory, the clerk discovered several missing items.
explanation_zh: While 引導的分詞構句省略主詞與 be 動詞時,動詞須用現在分詞 checking,表示主動進行「清點庫存」的動作。

sentence: Each of the branches ___________ required to submit monthly sales reports.
explanation_zh: "Each of + 複數名詞" 視為單數概念,動詞須用單數形式 is。

sentence: The series of workshops ___________ scheduled for next month.
explanation_zh: 句子主詞是單數的 series,「of workshops」只是修飾語,動詞須配合 series 用單數 is。

sentence: Neither the supervisor nor the technicians ___________ satisfied with the new system.
explanation_zh: neither A nor B 的句型中,動詞須與最接近的主詞一致,此處最近的是複數的 technicians,故用 are。

sentence: The amount of paperwork ___________ increased due to the new regulations.
explanation_zh: "The amount of + 不可數名詞" 視為單數,動詞須用單數 has。

sentence: A number of clients ___________ expressed interest in the new product line.
explanation_zh: "A number of + 複數名詞" 表示「許多」,視為複數,動詞須用 have。

sentence: Everybody on the project team ___________ expected to attend the kickoff meeting.
explanation_zh: 不定代名詞 everybody 視為單數,動詞須用 is。

sentence: The staff ___________ divided on the proposed change in work hours.
explanation_zh: staff 為集合名詞,在此強調整體為一單位意見分歧,動詞用單數 is。

sentence: Most of the equipment in the lab ___________ outdated and needs replacement.
explanation_zh: equipment 為不可數名詞,"Most of + 不可數名詞" 動詞須用單數 is。

sentence: The ___________ of the merger surprised many industry analysts.
explanation_zh: 空格為句子主詞,須用名詞 announcement,而非動詞 announce 或其分詞形式。

sentence: Staff must submit a formal ___________ before requesting reimbursement for travel expenses.
explanation_zh: formal 為形容詞,後面須接名詞 application(申請),而非動詞、動作者名詞 applicant 或分詞 applied。

sentence: The ___________ between the vendor and the retailer took nearly a year to finalize.
explanation_zh: 空格為句子主詞,須用名詞 negotiation(協商),而非動詞 negotiate、人物名詞 negotiator 或形容詞 negotiable。

sentence: The company announced a new ___________ package for all part-time workers.
explanation_zh: 空格與 package 組成複合名詞,須用名詞 benefit,而非動詞分詞形式或形容詞 beneficial。

sentence: Customer ___________ dropped noticeably after the price increase last quarter.
explanation_zh: 空格與 customer 組成複合名詞作句子主詞,須用名詞 loyalty,而非形容詞 loyal 或副詞 loyally。

sentence: The firm's ___________ into overseas markets has been remarkably successful.
explanation_zh: the firm's 為所有格,後面須接名詞 expansion 作主詞,而非動詞 expand 或其變化形。

sentence: The manager requested a full ___________ of the incident before deciding on disciplinary action.
explanation_zh: full 為形容詞修飾名詞,空格須用名詞 investigation,而非動詞 investigate 或形容詞 investigative。

sentence: The ___________ of the new assembly line reduced production time by twenty percent.
explanation_zh: 空格為句子主詞,須用名詞 installation(安裝),而非動詞 install 或其分詞形式。

sentence: The new hire adapted ___________ to the fast-paced environment of the trading floor.
explanation_zh: 空格修飾動詞 adapted,須用副詞 quickly,而非形容詞 quick 或名詞 quickness。

sentence: The revised contract terms were ___________ favorable to both parties involved.
explanation_zh: 空格修飾形容詞 favorable,須用副詞 surprisingly,而非形容詞 surprising/surprised 或動詞 surprise。

sentence: The shipment arrived ___________ late because of the severe storm along the coast.
explanation_zh: 空格修飾形容詞 late,須用副詞 unusually,而非形容詞 unusual 或名詞 unusualness。

sentence: It is ___________ essential that all staff attend the mandatory safety briefing.
explanation_zh: 空格修飾形容詞 essential,須用副詞 absolutely,而非形容詞 absolute 或名詞 absoluteness。

sentence: The technician repaired the assembly machine ___________ before the next shift began.
explanation_zh: 空格修飾動詞 repaired,須用副詞 swiftly,而非形容詞 swift 或名詞 swiftness。

sentence: Despite the ___________ delay at customs, the shipment reached the port on time.
explanation_zh: 空格修飾名詞 delay,須用形容詞 unexpected,而非副詞 unexpectedly 或名詞 unexpectedness。

sentence: The proposal to relocate the office was ___________ approved by the committee.
explanation_zh: 空格修飾被動語態動詞 was approved,須用副詞 unanimously,而非形容詞 unanimous 或名詞 unanimity。

sentence: Clients found the redesigned website ___________ user-friendly and easy to navigate.
explanation_zh: 空格修飾形容詞 user-friendly,須用副詞 exceptionally,而非形容詞 exceptional 或名詞 exception。

sentence: The workshop has been postponed ___________ next Tuesday due to a scheduling conflict.
explanation_zh: postpone until + 新時間,表示「延後至」,故用 until,強調延後到某個未來時間點。

sentence: Payment must be made ___________ thirty days of receiving the invoice.
explanation_zh: within + 一段時間,表示「在……期限之內」,符合「三十天內」的語意。

sentence: The new regional branch will officially open ___________ March 15th.
explanation_zh: 特定日期前須用介系詞 on,故用 on March 15th,而非 at(用於時刻)或 in(用於月份、年份)。

sentence: Please leave your visitor badge ___________ the security desk before you exit the building.
explanation_zh: 表示某個具體地點(定點)時用 at,故用 at the security desk。

sentence: Several flights were cancelled ___________ severe weather conditions at the airport.
explanation_zh: due to 為介系詞片語,後接名詞片語表示原因;although/unless 是連接詞須接子句,despite 表讓步,皆不符合此處語意。

sentence: The annual report must be completed ___________ the end of the fiscal year.
explanation_zh: by 表示「最晚不超過某期限」,符合「會計年度結束前完成」的語意。

sentence: The training program is intended ___________ newly promoted supervisors.
explanation_zh: be intended for + 對象,表示「為……而設計」,故用 for。

sentence: The meeting ran ___________ 6 p.m. before both sides finally reached an agreement.
explanation_zh: until 表示動作持續到某時間點為止,符合「會議持續到六點」的語意,而 by 強調期限而非持續。

sentence: The vendor missed the delivery deadline; ___________, the client canceled the entire order.
explanation_zh: 前後句為因果關係(供應商未如期交貨,因此客戶取消訂單),須用表示結果的連接副詞 therefore。

sentence: The prototype met all technical specifications; ___________, it failed the final safety test.
explanation_zh: 前後句語意轉折(符合規格卻未通過安全測試),須用表示對比的連接副詞 however。

sentence: ___________ the budget cuts, the department still managed to complete the project on time.
explanation_zh: 空格後接名詞片語 the budget cuts,須用介系詞性連接詞 despite,而 although/because/since 之後須接完整子句。

sentence: ___________ the price increased sharply, demand for the product remained strong.
explanation_zh: 空格後接完整子句(the price increased...),須用連接詞 although,而 despite/because of/due to 之後須接名詞片語。

sentence: The airline raised its ticket prices; ___________, passenger numbers continued to grow.
explanation_zh: 前後句語意轉折(漲價卻乘客人數仍成長),須用表示讓步轉折的連接副詞 nevertheless。

sentence: The engineer identified the structural defect early; ___________, a costly recall was avoided.
explanation_zh: 前後句為因果關係(及早發現瑕疵,因此避免召回),須用表示結果的連接副詞 consequently。

sentence: The store extended its business hours; ___________, evening sales rose sharply.
explanation_zh: 前後句為因果關係(延長營業時間,因此晚間業績上升),須用表示結果的連接副詞 thus。

sentence: ___________ the invoice is paid in full, the goods will not be released from the warehouse.
explanation_zh: Unless 表示「除非」,相當於 if...not,符合「除非付清款項,否則不會放行」的條件語意。

sentence: Please remember to bring ___________ own identification badge to the security office.
explanation_zh: 空格後接名詞 badge,須用所有格形容詞 your,而 yours 是所有格代名詞,不接名詞。

sentence: The CEO addressed the shareholders ___________ during the annual meeting instead of sending a representative.
explanation_zh: 此處用強調用法的反身代名詞 herself,強調「執行長親自」出席致詞。

sentence: If the vending machine malfunctions again, facilities will replace it with ___________.
explanation_zh: another 表示「另一台(同類但非特定的)」,符合泛指再換一台新機器的語意;the other 用於限定「兩者中的另一個」,不符此處語意。

sentence: Of the two candidates shortlisted for the position, one accepted the offer, but ___________ declined.
explanation_zh: 談到兩者中的「一個…另一個」時,第二個須用 the other,表示剩下唯一確定的那一個。

sentence: The interns were instructed to hand in ___________ evaluation forms no later than Friday.
explanation_zh: 空格後接名詞 forms,須用所有格形容詞 their,而 theirs 是所有格代名詞,不可直接修飾名詞。

sentence: This parking space is reserved for the director, and that one over there is ___________.
explanation_zh: 空格單獨作補語,不接名詞,須用所有格代名詞 theirs,而 their 是所有格形容詞須接名詞。

sentence: Some employees prefer working remotely, while ___________ still choose to commute to the office.
explanation_zh: 與前面的 some 相對應,表示「另一部分不特定的人」,須用代名詞 others,而 other 須接名詞、the other 限定為剩下唯一的一個。

sentence: The board gave the newly appointed CEO of the company full authority to restructure ___________ management team.
explanation_zh: 空格指的是前面提到的 the company(單數),須用所有格形容詞 its;it's 則是 it is 的縮寫,文法上不可修飾名詞。

sentence: This year's export volume is ___________ than last year's.
explanation_zh: 句尾有 than,須用比較級 higher,而非原級 high 或最高級 highest。

sentence: Of all the vendors reviewed, this one offered the ___________ contract terms.
explanation_zh: of all the vendors 表示三者以上的比較,須用最高級 the most favorable。

sentence: The updated engine runs ___________ quietly than the previous model.
explanation_zh: 多音節副詞 quietly 的比較級須加 more,並搭配句尾的 than 使用。

sentence: The earlier the order is placed, the ___________ the discount offered.
explanation_zh: "The + 比較級..., the + 比較級..." 為對等比較句型,前後都須用比較級,故用 bigger。

sentence: This warehouse is far ___________ spacious than the old one, although the rent is higher.
explanation_zh: far 用來加強比較級語氣,多音節形容詞 spacious 的比較級須加 more,並搭配 than 使用。

sentence: Among all the regional offices, the Tokyo branch reports the ___________ profit.
explanation_zh: among all the regional offices 表示三者以上的比較,須用最高級 the most,修飾不可數名詞 profit。

sentence: As the product launch date nears, the team is working ___________ than before.
explanation_zh: 句尾有 than before,須用比較級 harder,而非原級 hard 或最高級 hardest。

sentence: The two supplier contracts are nearly identical, but this one is slightly ___________ comprehensive.
explanation_zh: 多音節形容詞 comprehensive 的比較級須加 more,slightly 修飾比較級表示「些微地」。

sentence: The employee ___________ presentation impressed the board works in the sales division.
explanation_zh: 空格後接名詞 presentation,表示「該員工的簡報」,須用所有格關係代名詞 whose。

sentence: The internal memo, ___________ was distributed yesterday afternoon, outlined the new dress code.
explanation_zh: 逗號隔開的非限定用法子句,先行詞為事物 memo,須用 which,that 通常不用於非限定用法逗號子句。

sentence: The supplier ___________ we selected last year has consistently delivered materials on time.
explanation_zh: 先行詞 supplier 是人,且在子句中作受詞(we selected 供應商),正式用法須用受格關係代名詞 whom。

sentence: This is the division ___________ oversees all international export operations.
explanation_zh: 先行詞 division 是事物,且在子句中作主詞,須用 that(或 which),whom 用於人、whose 為所有格、what 不可接先行詞。

sentence: Managers ___________ teams missed the quarterly quota must submit an improvement plan.
explanation_zh: 空格後接名詞 teams,表示「經理的團隊」,須用所有格關係代名詞 whose。

sentence: The overseas factory ___________ the components are manufactured is located near Ho Chi Minh City.
explanation_zh: 先行詞 factory 為地點,子句中缺少地方副詞而非受詞,須用關係副詞 where。

sentence: The exact reason ___________ the merger negotiations fell through has never been disclosed.
explanation_zh: 先行詞 reason 表示原因,須用關係副詞 why 引導子句說明原因。

sentence: The supervisor, ___________ has been with the firm for over two decades, is retiring next month.
explanation_zh: 逗號隔開的非限定用法子句,先行詞 supervisor 是人且在子句中作主詞,須用 who。

sentence: The manager gave the new hire some ___________ advice about managing a heavy workload.
explanation_zh: sensible 表示「明智的、合理的」,符合語意;sensitive 表示「敏感的、易受傷害的」,兩字意思不同,是常見的字義混淆考點。

sentence: The design team came up with an ___________ solution to the packaging problem.
explanation_zh: imaginative 表示「有創意的、想像力豐富的」,符合語意;imaginary 表示「虛構的、不真實的」,兩字意思不同,容易混淆。

sentence: The witness provided a ___________ account of the warehouse accident to investigators.
explanation_zh: credible 表示「可信的」,符合語意;credulous 表示「輕信的、易受騙的」,兩字拼法相近但意思不同,是常見的混淆詞。

sentence: The ___________ new hire finished the entire project two weeks ahead of schedule.
explanation_zh: industrious 表示「勤奮的」,符合語意;industrial 表示「工業的」,兩字拼法相近但意思完全不同,是常見的字義混淆考點。

sentence: Over the past decade, the firm has built a ___________ reputation in the shipping industry.
explanation_zh: respectable 表示「值得尊敬的、聲譽良好的」,符合語意;respectful 表示「表示尊敬的」,兩字意思不同,容易混淆。

sentence: The new onboarding program has proven ___________ to first-year employees.
explanation_zh: beneficial 表示「有益的」(形容詞),符合語意;beneficiary 表示「受益人」(名詞),兩字拼法相近但詞性與意思不同。

sentence: All employee salary information is strictly ___________ and must not be shared.
explanation_zh: confidential 表示「機密的」,符合語意;confident 表示「有自信的」,兩字拼法相近但意思完全不同,是常見的字義混淆考點。

sentence: Only full-time staff members are ___________ for the year-end bonus program.
explanation_zh: eligible 表示「符合資格的」,符合語意;illegible 表示「難以辨認的(字跡)」,兩字拼法相近但意思完全不同,是常見的混淆詞。
